page_title: AI App Builder for Next.js, Supabase & Vercel | Massvai

sources.entry: Massvai - AI full-stack app builder that turns a prompt into a working Next.js app with database, auth and deployment. #freemium

summary.name: Massvai
summary.one_liner: Massvai is an AI app builder that turns a text prompt into an exportable Next.js and TypeScript project with live preview, Supabase, GitHub sync, and Vercel deployment.
use_cases: Building a SaaS MVP with auth and dashboards
Generating a Next.js app from a product brief
Creating internal tools with a database
Prototyping and deploying a landing page
Exporting generated code to a GitHub repository
summary.what_it_does: Massvai takes a plain-language description (optionally with a screenshot or reference file) and has an AI agent plan and write a Next.js project in TypeScript. A live preview shows the build as it progresses, with durable progress, tool history, Stop and Retry controls. Supabase can be connected for auth and database, and the project can be synced to GitHub. Users can review and export every generated file, then deploy to Vercel through a guided flow. The page says code is exportable with no lock-in.
notable: Generates Next.js 15 and React 19 projects with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
Live preview with HMR while the agent works
Every generated file can be exported; GitHub sync and one-click Vercel deploy
Credit-based plans: Free (100 welcome credits), Builder $25/month (1,500 credits), Pro $49/month (4,000 credits)
caveats: Paid plans are credit-based; credits are charged by actual model token usage
Free tier has limited credits (100 welcome credits) and community support only
Supabase setup assistance and version history are listed as Pro features
